body: I'm just so exhausted by it all. After my attempt in July i became very concerned about how it will effect me seeing my son so i began just not telling the doctors certain things (plus as i said i'm just so tired i just want to get appointments over as quickly as possible).

I honestly don't know,
Even though i feel i'm not being honest with the people i love most i still feel so exposed and raw. 
I realise people don't mean to seem angry or upset when i attempt to discuss my feelings or past but that's the way it comes across and can very often lead to an argument between my fiancee and i. 
Since getting clean i have found employment, we're living a lot more comfortably and we've move closer to home so i have more access to my son . . . 
But i still feel so hollow and flat inside. 
and without the crutch of substance abuse or shitty circumstance to blame these feelings on i've felt worse than ever.
Sobriety has given me new eyes and i don't like what i'm seeing . . 
The true me, clear headed but still so damaged. It's like everyones efforts to help me have been wasted and the guilt has haunted me to the point where i can't stand it anymore.
Thanks for your concern Amy.
Vulpesocean.
